title: South Wind, Clear Sky (Gaifū kaisei), also known as Red Fuji, from the series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei)
credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Henry L. Phillips Collection, Bequest of Henry L. Phillips, 1939 (JP2960)
notes: Cropped inside the trimmed sheet edge and resized to 2000 px; the blocks file is our own separation of this image into six coverage maps (key, pale ground, red, sky, forest, summit).

title: Sudden Shower over Shin-Ōhashi Bridge and Atake (Ōhashi Atake no yūdachi), from the series One Hundred Famous Views of Edo (Meisho Edo hyakkei)
notes: Cropped to the sheet with its seals and resized to 1600 px wide; the blocks file is our own separation into twelve coverage maps (key, yellow, red, green, river, sky, far shore, piers, deep water, dusk bokashi, two rain blocks).
